snippet.title: ASBAK - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Asbak is a fast-paced hack-and-slash platformer that weaves the chaos of roguelikes, the depth of character-action RPGs, and the heart of a story-driven adventure into one relentless experience. In a world where the veil between the physical world and the paranormal realm has been torn apart, Demons flood the entire nation and you need to slay them with style — one battle, one story, one soul at a time. 

Wishlist & try demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2932110/Asbak/

Developer: Team Fossil, Vifth Floor
Website: https://asbak.vifthfloor.moe/
X: https://x.com/ASBAK_Game

#indiegame #hackandslash #actionrpg
